text: ໂອ້ໂຫ ພີ່ນ້ອງເອີ້ຍ! ມື້ນີ້ມີເລື່ອງມັນໆ ມາເລົ່າສູ່ຟັງ. ບານເຕະຄືນນີ້ ບໍ່ທຳມະດາແທ້ໆ, ເຊື່ອບໍ່ວ່າເກີດຫຍັງຂຶ້ນ?
desc: An adult woman around thirty with a clear medium-pitched female voice, not high-pitched. Passionate, excited football fan telling a story to friends, playful and dramatic, expressive, not a news reader
label: ສາວຊິ່ງ ມັນ ຕື່ນເຕັ້ນ
